item.title: CVE-2026-128424 [CVSS:3.1 5.3 MEDIUM]
item.description:
A flaw was found in Kroxylicious. The ACL authorizer's rules-file parser unquotes `matching /…/` regular-expression literals using the string unquoting rules, which strips every backslash escape. As a result, an allow rule such as `matching /orders\.v1/` is compiled as the regex `orders.v1`, which also matches unintended names such as `ordersXv1`, and character classes such as `\d` and `\w` lose their special meaning. Allow rules written with regex escapes can therefore apply to more resources than the author intended. Depending on the ACL configuration, this may allow an authenticated Kafka client to access a resource (such as read or write a topic) that should have been denied.
Score: 5.3 (MEDIUM) Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N

item.title: CVE-2026-120033 [CVSS:4.0 6 MEDIUM]
item.description:
In FRRouting 10.1 and later, bgpd does not correctly close a BGP session when the Send Hold Timer (RFC 9687) expires, i.e. when a neighbor has stopped accepting data from the router for twice the hold time. The connection is closed, but bgpd still considers the session to be up. A BGP neighbor that keeps sending KEEPALIVEs but stops reading from its connection, at a time when the router has a large amount of data to send to it (for example while sending it a full routing table), can trigger this. If the neighbor announced Graceful Restart support, bgpd crashes shortly after the session is closed, taking down all BGP sessions on the router, and the neighbor can repeat this each time bgpd restarts. Otherwise, the session stays stuck in the Established state: the neighbor's routes stay installed and keep being advertised to other peers, and the neighbor cannot reconnect until an operator clears the session manually. The neighbor does not need to be malicious; an overloaded or stuck peer can trigger the same behavior. No special configuration is required: any established BGP neighbor can trigger the issue, and Graceful Restart helper mode, which leads to the crash, is enabled by default.
Score: 6 (MEDIUM) Vector: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:N/VC:N/VI:L/VA:H/SC:N/SI:L/SA:L/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:N/R:A/V:X/RE:X/U:X

item.title: CVE-2026-11732 [CVSS:4.0 6.3 MEDIUM]
item.description:
An insufficient input validation vulnerability in the website blocking feature (Block Sites) of the listed NETGEAR router models allows a network-adjacent attacker with access to the local network (such as through Wi-Fi credentials) to run unauthorized commands on the router. This vulnerability could affect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected router. It applies only when the Block Sites feature is turned on.

item.title: CVE-2026-126119
item.description: The Streamit WordPress plugin before 1.3.10 does not perform any authorization or nonce verification on one of its unauthenticated AJAX routes, which invokes an attacker-supplied PHP function with an attacker-supplied argument array, allowing unauthenticated attackers to call arbitrary functions (for example to create an administrator account), leading to privilege escalation and remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-125912
item.description: The WP Ultimate CSV Importer WordPress plugin before 9.2 does not restrict the destination filename and extension, nor validate the fetched content type, when importing remote media, allowing an Administrator of a Multisite subsite to write and execute arbitrary PHP in the shared WordPress context despite not being a Network Administrator and being unable to install WP Ultimate CSV Importer WordPress plugin before 9.2 or edit files.

item.title: CVE-2026-124833
item.description: The Ahime Image Printer WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not validate the name, extension or type of uploaded files before writing them to disk, allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary files, including PHP, and execute code on the server.

item.title: CVE-2026-124822
item.description: The Easy DragDrop File Uploader WordPress plugin before 1.1.10 does not validate a user-supplied path before deleting it, allowing unauthenticated users to delete arbitrary files and directories on the server, such as wp-config.php.

item.title: CVE-2026-124763
item.description: The Woocommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin through 1.1.0 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks in one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to overwrite any site option with the URL of an uploaded image or an empty value, breaking the site (for example by changing its URL or active , or deactivating every Woocommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin through 1.1.0).

item.title: CVE-2026-124664
item.description: The Mine CloudVod WordPress plugin before 2.6.7 does not check whether the requester is enrolled in a course, or authorised at all, before returning the course's full curriculum together with the raw content of every published lesson, allowing unauthenticated visitors to retrieve paid lesson content, such as direct video source URLs, and the passwords of password-protected lessons.

item.title: CVE-2026-123711
item.description: The WPCOM Member WordPress plugin before 1.8.3 does not limit or bind attempts to verify WeChat login codes, allowing unauthenticated attackers to brute-force a code issued to another user and log in as that user, including administrators, when WeChat official-account keyword login is enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-123670
item.description: The Essential Real Estate WordPress plugin before 5.3.6 does not verify that the recipients it allows for its contact email action are legitimate, allowing users with the self-registered Customer role to add any address to that allowlist so that unauthenticated users can then send emails with attacker-controlled content to it through the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-123124
item.description: The WooCommerce Vindi Pagamento WordPress plugin through 0.8.3 does not perform any authorisation check when updating an order's shipment tracking code, and does not escape that code when displaying it on the order edit page, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators and shop managers who view an order paid through the gateway. The stored payload is only rendered on sites using WooCommerce's legacy (WordPress posts) order storage.

item.title: CVE-2026-123097
item.description: The WP Remote Users Sync WordPress plugin before 2.2.1 does not restrict which account fields a synchronised site may set when it creates or updates users, allowing a site holding the shared synchronisation keys to assign the administrator role, modify any existing account and write arbitrary user metadata, bypassing the receiving site's role and metadata restrictions.

item.title: CVE-2026-123093

item.title: CVE-2026-120407
item.description: The Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 6.2.5 does not restrict which user properties a form field's default value can be populated from, allowing users with the Editor role and above to obtain the password hash and sensitive user meta (such as two-factor secrets) of higher-privileged users, including administrators, who view and submit the form.

item.title: CVE-2026-118065
item.description: The Advance Guest Post WordPress plugin through 1.9 does not perform any authorization or ownership check when deleting media attachments, relying only on a nonce exposed to every site visitor, allowing unauthenticated users to permanently delete arbitrary Media Library attachments and their files.

item.title: CVE-2026-118064
item.description:
The Advance Guest Post WordPress plugin through 1.9 does not properly restrict or validate file uploads, authorizing an upload action with a nonce exposed to every front-end visitor and checking only a file's leading bytes, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary PHP files and execute code remotely.
Successful exploitation additionally requires the target to run PHP 7.x; on PHP 8.0 and later the vulnerable code path raises a fatal error before the file is written.

item.title: CVE-2026-118063
item.description: The Advance Guest Post WordPress plugin through 1.9 does not properly validate uploaded files, relying on a case-sensitive and incomplete extension check that unauthenticated users can trivially bypass, allowing them to upload arbitrary files, including executable PHP variants, into a web-reachable directory, which can lead to remote code execution depending on the server configuration.

item.title: CVE-2026-116059
item.description: The LetsRecover WordPress plugin through 1.2.0 does not sanitize a user-supplied value that is used as a database column name in one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated attackers to append SQL to the query and read arbitrary data from the database, which is then returned through a second unauthenticated action.

item.title: CVE-2026-109832 [CVSS:3.1 7.5 HIGH]
item.description:
A flaw was found in gnome-remote-desktop as shipped in Red Hat Enterprise Linux. In the VNC TLS I/O handlers, retryable GnuTLS results (GNUTLS_E_AGAIN and GNUTLS_E_INTERRUPTED) are handled with an unbounded busy loop instead of yielding to the event loop. A remote attacker who can reach an enabled VNC TLS listener can cause the event-loop thread to spin at high CPU with no forward progress, resulting in denial of service.
Score: 7.5 (HIGH) Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H

item.title: CVE-2026-6467 [CVSS:3.1 7.2 HIGH]
item.description:
Uncontrolled search path element in PostgreSQL CREATE EXTENSION allows an attacker with database-level CREATE privilege to execute arbitrary code as the bootstrap superuser, via ALTER SCHEMA ... RENAME or CREATE EXTENSION ... SCHEMA "$user". ALTER EXTENSION was also affected. A trusted-extension script located the wrong object and executed arbitrary SQL of the attacker's choice. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
Score: 7.2 (HIGH) Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

item.title: CVE-2026-6460 [CVSS:3.1 8.8 HIGH]
item.description:
Type confusion in PostgreSQL allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via ALTER ... SET DATA TYPE primarily. Other DDL attack routes exist, such as "ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN; ROLLBACK; ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN". The system had inadequate tracking of typed values, and values were not self-identifying. Stale values could appear in data dictionary entries, PL/pgSQL variables, and many other parts of the system. PostgreSQL Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
Score: 8.8 (HIGH) Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
